newsitem.title: USA: Roosevelt Fin'l votes special dividend.
newsitem.headline: Roosevelt Fin'l votes special dividend.

text.p: Roosevelt Financial Group Inc said Thursday its directors approved payment of a quarterly dividend of $0.225 which includes a $0.055 special dividend related to the company's proposed merger with Mercantile Bancorp Inc.

The special dividend ensures that Roosevelt shareholders do not receive a shortfall based on the record and payment dates of Roosevelt's anticipated last dividend prior to its merger with Mercantile and the record and payment dates of Mercantile's first dividend following the merger.
The $0.225 dividend includes a regular quarterly dividend of $0.17 and a special transition payment of $0.055. The dividend is payable May 30, record May 15.

In late December 1996, Roosevelt and Mercantile agreed to merge in a transaction offering Roosevelt holders $0.22 in cash, or 0.4211 share of Mercantile common stock. The deal requires approval by Roosevelt shareholders and regulators. It is expects to be completed in mid-1997.
